component.name: Splice
component.summary: Share one keyboard and mouse across your Tailscale machines

description.p: Splice is a software KVM. Move the pointer through a screen edge and it continues on the neighbouring computer, with the keyboard and clipboard following. Machines discover each other over your Tailscale network, so there is nothing to configure beyond arranging them.
On Linux, Splice uses the Wayland Input Capture and Remote Desktop portals and requires GNOME or KDE Plasma running Wayland.
